description: Linear Merge: takes eight monophonic gate and CV pairs and gives back one gate and one CV, so several sequencers can be reduced to a single melodic line

params.text: Cycles how the CV output is refreshed: S&H samples it as the output gate goes high and holds it until the next rise, T&H follows the chosen CV for as long as that gate stays high
Cycles which of the high channels sets the CV output: First and Last by position from the top, Min and Max by voltage, Avg the mean of them and Sum their total

inputs.text: One of the eight CV inputs, taken when the gate beside it is high and the selection button picks that channel
One of the eight gate inputs, reading high above 2V and low below 0.2V; while it is high the CV input beside it is eligible to be chosen
Restricts the gate inputs to changing on the rising edge of a clock, which is what puts the output gate on a timing grid; it reads high above 2V and low below 0.2V. Unpatched, gates pass at once

outputs.text: Carries the CV of the channel the selection button picks, refreshed as the mode button says
Carries 10V while any gate input is high and 0V when none is

notes: place a Linear Merge Expander immediately to the right for another eight CV inputs and another CV output; there is no limit on how many expanders follow
menu: Add CV Expander — places a Linear Merge Expander immediately to the right
